project_type: Expo SDK ~57 / React Native 0.86.3 / React 19 mobile app with Expo Router file-based routing and a Supabase (Postgres) backend. CNG — no ios/ or android/ edits.
build_system: Expo + Metro. No separate compile step for RN. TypeScript checked via `tsc --noEmit`. Supabase CLI applies migrations/seeds via `npx supabase db reset`.
test_framework: Jest with the `jest-expo` preset (jest.config.js). Pure logic in colocated `*.test.ts`; component tests via @testing-library/react-native. Supabase Edge Function tests under supabase/functions/ are excluded (Deno). DB/RLS tests under supabase/tests/*.test.sql.
verification_instructions: From the worktree root run, in order: `npx expo lint` (no errors), `npx tsc --noEmit` (no errors), `npm test` (all suites pass), `npx expo-doctor` (no new issues). For DB changes, `npx supabase db reset` must apply all migrations and seeds cleanly. Confirm package.json gained no new runtime dependency (FR-16/NFR-4).
snapshot_or_generated_files: supabase/seed/catalog.generated.sql and src/types/db.ts are hand-maintained (db.ts is NOT codegen here) — edit db.ts by hand to add new tables/RPCs. No codegen step to run for this task.
environment_constraints: Do NOT add runtime dependencies; all needed libs (react-native-svg 15.15.4, @tanstack/react-query ^5, zustand ^5, zod ^4, @supabase/supabase-js ^2) are already present. Do NOT add expo-crypto to this feature (simulation ids are server-generated; see NIT-2). Never edit ios/ or android/. Never edit an already-applied migration — add NEW timestamped files. Use `bunx`? No — this project uses npm/npx (package-lock.json present, no bun.lock). Before any Expo/RN API usage consult https://docs.expo.dev/versions/v57.0.0/ and https://docs.expo.dev/llms.txt, not memory.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: routes thin and only under app/ (this repo uses app/ at root, NOT src/app/); all non-route code outside app/. Use Expo Router (Link, router, useLocalSearchParams from 'expo-router'). Run `npx expo lint` and `npx tsc --noEmit` before declaring done. Prefer Expo modules; no new native modules/config plugins.
key_patterns: Money is integer cents only via src/lib/money.ts (pctChange returns basis points or null; formatCents/formatSignedCents/formatPercent; centsToDollars for charts only; never float on money). Data hooks: plain async fetch + thin useQuery wrapper, NO user id passed (RLS scopes rows) — see src/features/explore/use-instruments.ts and src/features/portfolio/use-portfolio.ts (PORTFOLIO_QUERY_KEY, missing quote => value 0). Mutations call supabase.rpc with no user id and map stable string error codes to friendly copy, invalidating queries on success — see src/features/trading/use-place-order.ts (mapPlaceOrderError). SVG charts: pure geometry module + thin renderer — see src/features/trading/components/chart-geometry.ts and line-chart.tsx. Shared UI from src/components/ui (Screen, StateView, Button, Card, Text, Disclaimer); theme via src/theme/theme-provider useTheme(). Tests mock supabase per-test with jest.mock('../../lib/supabase', ...) — there is NO shared __mocks__/supabase module.
db_patterns: Migrations are separate timestamped files YYYYMMDDNNNNNN_name.sql: tables file, then RLS+grants file, then RPCs file. Next free slot after 20250107* is 20250108*. User-owned tables use `user_id text references public.profiles(user_id) on delete cascade`; SELECT policy `using (user_id = (select public.current_user_id()))`. Reference tables: `for select to authenticated using (true)`. Always `revoke all on <tables> from anon, authenticated;` then `grant select on <tables> to authenticated;` — NO direct write grants. Writes go through `create function ... language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public` deriving `v_uid := public.current_user_id()` (raise not_authenticated if null), granted to authenticated only. See 20250105000002_trading_ledger.sql, 20250105000003_market_trading_rls_and_grants.sql, 20250105000006_place_market_order_rpc.sql. instruments has 11 seeded GICS sectors; seed is idempotent on conflict do update (supabase/seed/instruments.sql) and registered in supabase/config.toml [db.seed] sql_paths. gen_random_uuid() available for uuid PKs.

src/types/db.ts (hand-maintained; add new tables + RPC signatures)
app/(tabs)/portfolio.tsx (entry point to add Stress Lab button; router.push)

directory_structure: app/ = Expo Router routes (root, NOT src/app/): (auth), (tabs), settings/, stock/, trade/, plus flat screens history.tsx/glossary.tsx; _layout.tsx defines navigators. src/features/<name>/ = feature modules (auth, explore, portfolio, trading, lessons, progress, watchlist, etc.) each with hooks, components/, README.md, colocated tests. src/lib/ = money, supabase client, auth0, query-client, sentry. src/components/ui = shared kit. src/theme = tokens + provider. src/types/db.ts = hand-maintained DB types. supabase/migrations = timestamped SQL; supabase/seed = seed SQL+CSV; supabase/tests = pgTAP-style *.test.sql. New feature code goes under src/features/stress-lab/ and app/stress-lab/.
